verdict.rationale: CLI flags like `--subagent claude` (yylo-docs-1) and benchmark 'model selectors' (yylo-docs-24) show a user can explicitly pick a model/agent, and yylo-docs-29 mentions delegating work 'across agents and models,' implying manual choice is possible. However, there is no documentation describing a default automatic-selection mode that this overrides, nor any UI/toggle for switching between auto and manual modes. Missing for 10: explicit description of an automatic model-selection default, a documented switch/toggle mechanism, and independent confirmation that manual overrides actually take effect at runtime.
